_comment: The CLI tools shipped in wows_toolkit_tools_<tag>_<platform>.zip, and the
name each one carries inside the archive.
Buck names a rust_binary's output after its crate, and a crate name cannot
contain a hyphen, so the built filename is not always the name the tool has
shipped under. Keeping the mapping here rather than letting the archive
inherit whatever Buck emitted is what stops a rename going out unnoticed.
package-tools.* fails when a listed target produces no output, when a
listed extra file is missing, or when the finished archive does not hold
exactly these names. It cannot notice a NEW shipped binary that nobody
added here, so a target added to the root BUCK file has to be added here
_extra_files_comment: wows_data_mgr locates its manifest by walking up from the working
directory, so game_versions.toml has to sit next to the binaries.
